title: Coherent coefficients and their colimit restrict to explicit tail opens
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $D:I^{op}\to Sch$ an inverse diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with any cone $c$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $F_i$ be abelian etale sheaves and let the inverse-image transitions $\varphi_f$ obey the canonical identity and composition equations. Let $G$ be a diagram on the cone point, with specified $eG_i:G_i\cong c_i^*F_i$ and canonical transition formula, and let $L$ be a colimit cocone of $G$. Fix $i_0$, a morphism $g_0:D_{i_0}\to X$, and an open $W$ of $X$. Use the explicit restricted diagram, cone, sheaves, transitions, tail inclusion $J$, and limit-coefficient isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-limit-open-restricted-system]. The restricted coefficients obey the canonical identity and composition equations, and the arrows of $G|_J$ pulled back to the limit open obey the canonical transition formula with these specified isomorphisms. The cocone $L|_J$ pulled back to the limit open is colimiting. Its coefficient leg after the inverse specified isomorphism equals openSquareCoefficient applied to the original leg $(eG_j)^{-1};L_j$. No compactness, scheme limit, allowed-stage predicate, or cohomological continuity is asserted.

proof.text: Apply tailOpenRestrictedSystem_coherence to obtain the restricted coefficient identity, composition and diagram-map equations for the explicit tailOpenLimitIso.

The tail inclusion is final: choose a common upper bound of each original index and i0; filteredness and the uniqueness of preorder morphisms give the finality criterion. Apply Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv, then isColimitOfPreserves for the inverse-image left adjoint.
Expand the inverse of tailOpenLimitIso, functoriality of inverse image, and the whiskered cocone leg. Reassociation gives exactly the defined openSquareCoefficient.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_limit_tail_open_coefficients
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (i₀ : I) (g₀ : D.obj (op i₀) ⟶ X) (W : X.Opens) :
    let DW := tailOpenDiagram D g₀ W
    let cW := tailOpenCone D c g₀ W
    let FW := tailOpenSheaf D g₀ W F
    let φW := @tailOpenCoefficient _ _ D _ _ g₀ W F φ
    let R := upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι
    let J := tailOpenInclusion i₀
    let GW := (J ⋙ G) ⋙ R
    let LW := R.mapCocone (L.whisker J)
    (∀ j, φW (𝟙 j) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (DW.map_id (op j)))).hom.app
        (FW j) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (DW.obj (op j))).hom.app (FW j)) ∧
    (∀ (j k l : Set.Ici i₀) (f : j ⟶ k) (g : k ⟶ l), φW (f ≫ g) =
      (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (DW.map g.op) (DW.map f.op)
        (DW.map (f ≫ g).op) (DW.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (FW j) ≫
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (DW.map g.op)).map (φW f) ≫ φW g) ∧
    (let eGW := tailOpenLimitIso D c g₀ W F G eG;
      (∀ (j k : Set.Ici i₀) (f : j ⟶ k), GW.map f =
        (eGW j).hom ≫
          (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (cW.π.app (op k)) (DW.map f.op)
            (cW.π.app (op j)) (cW.w f.op).symm).hom.app (FW j) ≫
          (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (cW.π.app (op k))).map (φW f) ≫
            (eGW k).inv) ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit LW) ∧
      (∀ j : Set.Ici i₀, (eGW j).inv ≫ LW.ι.app j =
        openSquareCoefficient (c.π.app (op j.val)) (tailStageOpen D g₀ W j).ι
          ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι (tailLimitOpenMap D c g₀ W j)
          (by simp only [tailLimitOpenMap, Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι]) (F j.val) L.pt
          ((eG j.val).inv ≫ L.ι.app j.val)))
